description: Forced headless Chromium browser renderer for JavaScript-heavy SPAs and dynamic webpages. Always executes Tier 3 isolated browser rendering and returns the post-JS rendered HTML DOM alongside extracted text, Markdown, links, and metadata. Do not use for PDFs or static pages (use fetch_webpage instead).

dismiss_cookies.description: Attempt to dismiss cookie/GDPR banners before extraction.
dismiss_cookies.title: Dismiss Cookies

max_chars.description: Maximum characters returned for content, Markdown, and HTML.
max_chars.title: Max Chars

only_main_content.description: Extract only main article/content (strips nav, footer, aside).
only_main_content.title: Only Main Content

scroll.description: Scroll down to trigger lazy-loaded content before extraction.
scroll.title: Scroll

url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS webpage URL for forced headless browser rendering.
url.title: Url

wait_for_selector.description: Optional CSS selector to wait for before extraction.
wait_for_selector.title: Wait For Selector

wait_ms.description: Optional extra wait in milliseconds (0-5000) after page load.
wait_ms.title: Wait Ms

name: render_webpage
